| USD | Approx. GBP |
|-----|-------------|
| $20 | £15.00 – £16.00 |

So, $20 is roughly **£15–£16** today. Exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so for an exact conversion you’d want to check a reliable financial source (e.g., a bank, a currency‑conversion website, or a financial news outlet) at the time you plan to make the transaction.
